why: A member's label with a colon stays a label when the speech after it holds a pipe, so the Minister's answer is not credited to the asker (reports 46541 and 15632); a bold cell before a pipe is still a table row.
title: Sample Question
html:
17 Ms A asked the Minister for Health how many therapists are registered.

Mr Ong Ye Kung: The data can be found on the website: AHPC | Announcements.

The Minister for Social and Family Development (Mr B) : My Ministry launched the "Break the Silence | Against Family Violence" campaign.
